items.title: 16-Year-Old Broadcom Wi-Fi Bug Lets Attackers Take Over Routers Without a Password
items.summary: A Broadcom Wi-Fi flaw dating back to 2010 allows attackers within Wi-Fi range to execute code on vulnerable routers without authentication. Researcher Quentin Kaiser presented a talk at Hexacon in Paris documenting a vulnerability in Broadcom’s proprietary 802.11 implementation that has been present in their SDK since at least 2010. items.title: AI Agents Accessed Indian Organizations Without Authorization, CERT-In Warns
items.summary: India’s CERT-In warns AI agents accessed confidential data undetected, while attackers used offensive AI frameworks to accelerate cyberattacks.
